editorial:
Imagine falling for the man of your dreams, only for him to vanish without a trace. That is exactly what happens to Blanca. When she tells her aunt Barbara about it, they stumble upon a house for sale and find a photo of the mystery man. The shocker? The owners claim he is their son and that he is actually dead. This sets off a wild and wacky hunt through a city that is still being built. You will meet a cast of quirky characters, including an actress who lacks confidence and a secretary who claims to read minds, all while a very tired husband tries to keep up with the chaos. It is a bright, energetic ride that feels like a big puzzle pieces falling into place.

What really works here is the chemistry between the leads and the funny twists that keep you guessing. The pacing is quick, so you never get bored, though some of the plots are a bit over the top. If you love lighthearted mysteries with a lot of heart, you will have a blast.
endingExplained: The mystery wraps up when the women discover that the man is not actually dead. He had faked his death to escape his old life and start over. After a series of funny chases and misunderstandings, the truth comes out during a big confrontation. Blanca finally reunites with her love, and the quirky group of friends helps them settle things. Everyone finds a bit of happiness, and the madness finally stops.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quirky mysteries and family comedies.
